t: You're looking at Chandos House, a Grade I listed townhouse at 2 Queen Anne Street in Marylebone. It was designed by Robert Adam, the Scottish neoclassical architect who was the most prominent in Georgian Britain, and built by William Adam and Company. It's seen as the first of a series of large London townhouses, including 20 St James's Square and Derby House. The 3rd Duke of Buckingham and Chandos, a close friend of Benjamin Disraeli, died here.
